title: Users unable to sign in to corporate portal
description: Multiple users cannot access the corporate application after entering valid credentials. Authentication requests fail across web and mobile channels. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected internal support users after overnight maintenance.
root_cause: A recently deployed identity-provider configuration contained an incorrect redirect URI and token audience, causing valid authentication responses to be rejected by the application.
resolution: Corrected the identity-provider redirect URI and token audience, validated SSO metadata, restarted the identity service, and confirmed successful login with test and affected user accounts.

title: Application cannot validate SAML assertion
description: Users cannot authenticate because the application rejects SAML assertions from the identity provider. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected customer transactions after a scheduled change.
root_cause: The SAML signing certificate used by the identity provider expired and the application trust store still referenced the old certificate.
resolution: Renewed the SAML signing certificate, imported the new public certificate into the application trust store, refreshed federation metadata, restarted authentication components, and verified SSO end to end.

title: API returns unauthorized for valid sessions
description: API requests return unauthorized even though the user session appears valid. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected customer transactions during peak business hours.
root_cause: Clock drift between application nodes and the identity provider exceeded the accepted token skew, causing otherwise valid access tokens to be treated as expired.
resolution: Synchronized system clocks using the approved NTP source, corrected token-skew configuration, cleared stale token caches, restarted affected nodes, and validated token lifetime across the cluster.

title: Database connection timeout in production
description: Services report connection pool exhaustion and cannot acquire a database session. Impact was observed in the primary region and affected remote employees after overnight maintenance.
root_cause: A connection leak in the application left database sessions open, exhausting the configured connection pool during peak workload.
resolution: Identified and fixed the unclosed connection path, terminated orphaned sessions, restarted the affected application instances, increased pool monitoring, and verified stable connection usage under load.

title: Application database credential expired
description: The application cannot connect to the database after the service-account password change. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected finance operations during peak business hours.
root_cause: The database service-account password was rotated in the vault but the application secret reference still pointed to the previous credential version.
resolution: Updated the application secret reference to the current vault version, refreshed runtime credentials, restarted the application safely, verified database access, and confirmed that no stale credentials remained.

title: Application pages slow due to long-running query
description: Database response time increased sharply and business transactions are timing out. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected multiple business teams during peak business hours.
root_cause: A newly introduced report executed a non-indexed query against a high-volume table, causing full table scans, CPU saturation, and lock contention.
resolution: Captured the execution plan, added the required composite index, optimized the query predicates, terminated blocking sessions, refreshed statistics, and confirmed normal response time with production-like load.

title: DNS lookup failure for service endpoint
description: Application nodes report DNS lookup timeouts for an internal endpoint. Impact was observed in the primary region and affected remote employees following a routine deployment.
root_cause: One internal DNS resolver held a stale record after the service IP change and continued serving an outdated address because cache invalidation failed.
resolution: Removed the stale DNS record, flushed resolver and client caches, corrected zone replication, validated TTL settings, and confirmed consistent name resolution from all application subnets.

title: Service unreachable across network zone
description: Application nodes cannot reach the backend service after a firewall policy update. Impact was observed in the primary region and affected customer transactions after a scheduled change.
root_cause: A firewall policy deployment omitted the application subnet from the approved source group, blocking required traffic to the backend service port.
resolution: Restored the approved source subnet to the firewall object group, validated the rule order and destination port, deployed the corrected policy, and confirmed connectivity from every application node.

title: VPN tunnel disconnects repeatedly
description: VPN authentication completes but the tunnel disconnects shortly afterward. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected internal support users during peak business hours.
root_cause: The VPN gateway authentication profile referenced an unavailable RADIUS node and failover timeout values were too high, causing session establishment to fail.
resolution: Removed the unhealthy RADIUS node from the active pool, corrected failover timers, validated gateway authentication and tunnel policies, and confirmed stable VPN access from external test networks.

title: Backend nodes removed from load balancer
description: The load balancer marks healthy application nodes as unavailable and user requests receive service errors. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected remote employees during peak business hours.
root_cause: The application health endpoint was moved during deployment but the load balancer continued probing the previous path, causing all healthy nodes to be marked down.
resolution: Updated the load-balancer health-check path and expected response code, restored nodes gradually, validated session persistence and traffic distribution, and monitored error rates until stable.

title: Application errors after production release
description: Users report errors in functionality that worked before the release. Impact was observed in the primary region and affected remote employees without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The deployment package introduced an incompatible configuration schema while the production environment retained values from the previous application version.
resolution: Rolled back to the last stable release, restored the compatible configuration schema, corrected the deployment migration, completed regression tests, and redeployed through the approved change process.

title: Application process repeatedly restarts
description: Application memory grows continuously until the process restarts. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected customer transactions after a scheduled change.
root_cause: An application cache retained unbounded session objects, causing progressive memory growth, garbage-collection pressure, and degraded response time.
resolution: Patched the cache eviction logic, cleared oversized caches, restarted instances in a rolling sequence, introduced memory alerts, and verified stable response time during peak-load testing.

title: Production service reads test endpoint
description: The application is calling the wrong downstream endpoint after configuration promotion. Impact was observed in the primary region and affected internal support users following a routine deployment.
root_cause: The environment-specific configuration file was packaged with a non-production endpoint and overrode the expected secret-managed setting at startup.
resolution: Corrected the production configuration source, removed the packaged override, restarted application nodes in sequence, validated downstream calls, and added deployment validation for environment-specific values.

root_cause: The underlying compute host experienced a hardware fault and high-availability evacuation did not complete because one virtual machine had an invalid placement constraint.
resolution: Removed the invalid placement constraint, migrated affected virtual machines to healthy hosts, replaced the failed host component, restored high-availability compliance, and verified application health.

root_cause: The renewed TLS certificate was installed on one load-balancer listener but not propagated to the secondary listener serving part of the traffic.
resolution: Installed the renewed certificate and full chain on every listener, corrected certificate binding, validated hostname coverage, tested TLS from multiple networks, and added expiry monitoring.

title: Cache cluster failover unsuccessful
description: Application sessions fail because the distributed cache is unavailable. Impact was observed in the production and affected customer transactions without a recent approved change.
root_cause: A high-cardinality cache key was created without an expiration time, consuming available memory and preventing normal session writes.
resolution: Removed the runaway key set, introduced mandatory TTL values, adjusted eviction policy, restarted affected replicas safely, added key-cardinality monitoring, and confirmed session stability.

title: Application rejects valid user credentials
description: Users began receiving login errors shortly after an identity service configuration change. The issue affects multiple business teams. Impact was observed in the production and affected internal support users without a recent approved change.
root_cause: A recently deployed identity-provider configuration contained an incorrect redirect URI and token audience, causing valid authentication responses to be rejected by the application.
resolution: Corrected the identity-provider redirect URI and token audience, validated SSO metadata, restarted the identity service, and confirmed successful login with test and affected user accounts.

title: Identity provider certificate validation failure
description: Users cannot authenticate because the application rejects SAML assertions from the identity provider. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected finance operations without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The SAML signing certificate used by the identity provider expired and the application trust store still referenced the old certificate.
resolution: Renewed the SAML signing certificate, imported the new public certificate into the application trust store, refreshed federation metadata, restarted authentication components, and verified SSO end to end.

title: API returns unauthorized for valid sessions
description: API requests return unauthorized even though the user session appears valid. Impact was observed in the primary region and affected finance operations following a routine deployment.
root_cause: Clock drift between application nodes and the identity provider exceeded the accepted token skew, causing otherwise valid access tokens to be treated as expired.
resolution: Synchronized system clocks using the approved NTP source, corrected token-skew configuration, cleared stale token caches, restarted affected nodes, and validated token lifetime across the cluster.

title: Intermittent database connectivity errors
description: Application requests fail because database connections time out during peak traffic. Impact was observed in the production and affected remote employees following a routine deployment.
root_cause: A connection leak in the application left database sessions open, exhausting the configured connection pool during peak workload.
resolution: Identified and fixed the unclosed connection path, terminated orphaned sessions, restarted the affected application instances, increased pool monitoring, and verified stable connection usage under load.

title: Service account authentication failure
description: The application cannot connect to the database after the service-account password change. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected multiple business teams without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The database service-account password was rotated in the vault but the application secret reference still pointed to the previous credential version.
resolution: Updated the application secret reference to the current vault version, refreshed runtime credentials, restarted the application safely, verified database access, and confirmed that no stale credentials remained.

title: Application pages slow due to long-running query
description: A reporting query consumes excessive CPU and blocks transactional workloads. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected multiple business teams without a recent approved change.
root_cause: A newly introduced report executed a non-indexed query against a high-volume table, causing full table scans, CPU saturation, and lock contention.
resolution: Captured the execution plan, added the required composite index, optimized the query predicates, terminated blocking sessions, refreshed statistics, and confirmed normal response time with production-like load.

root_cause: Regional vCPU consumption reached the subscription quota after temporary test resources were not decommissioned.
resolution: Removed unused test resources, requested and received the required quota increase, reran infrastructure deployment, added quota monitoring, and established automated expiry tags for temporary resources.

title: Endpoint package repeatedly retries
description: The managed endpoint cannot install the approved application package. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected finance operations following a routine deployment.
root_cause: The installation package detection rule checked an outdated registry path and incorrectly reported successful installations as missing.
resolution: Corrected the detection rule, superseded the faulty package, synchronized endpoint-management policy, retried installation, and verified application launch on representative devices.

title: Channel messages delayed
description: Multiple users experience repeated sign-in prompts in the collaboration client. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected customer transactions without a recent approved change.
root_cause: A stale authentication cache persisted after a tenant policy update and conflicted with newly issued access tokens.
resolution: Cleared the affected client authentication cache, refreshed tokens, validated tenant policy assignment, updated the client where required, and confirmed messaging and meeting functionality.

title: Web service TLS handshake failure
description: TLS handshakes fail because the endpoint presents an unexpected certificate. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected customer transactions after overnight maintenance.
root_cause: The renewed TLS certificate was installed on one load-balancer listener but not propagated to the secondary listener serving part of the traffic.
resolution: Installed the renewed certificate and full chain on every listener, corrected certificate binding, validated hostname coverage, tested TLS from multiple networks, and added expiry monitoring.

title: Cache cluster failover unsuccessful
description: Application sessions fail because the distributed cache is unavailable. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected multiple business teams following a routine deployment.
root_cause: A high-cardinality cache key was created without an expiration time, consuming available memory and preventing normal session writes.
resolution: Removed the runaway key set, introduced mandatory TTL values, adjusted eviction policy, restarted affected replicas safely, added key-cardinality monitoring, and confirmed session stability.

title: Application rejects valid user credentials
description: Users began receiving login errors shortly after an identity service configuration change. The issue affects multiple business teams. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected multiple business teams after a scheduled change.
root_cause: A recently deployed identity-provider configuration contained an incorrect redirect URI and token audience, causing valid authentication responses to be rejected by the application.
resolution: Corrected the identity-provider redirect URI and token audience, validated SSO metadata, restarted the identity service, and confirmed successful login with test and affected user accounts.

title: Login blocked by expired signing certificate
description: SSO login stopped working after the signing certificate reached its expiry date. Impact was observed in the primary region and affected multiple business teams following a routine deployment.
root_cause: The SAML signing certificate used by the identity provider expired and the application trust store still referenced the old certificate.
resolution: Renewed the SAML signing certificate, imported the new public certificate into the application trust store, refreshed federation metadata, restarted authentication components, and verified SSO end to end.

title: API returns unauthorized for valid sessions
description: Active users are unexpectedly redirected to sign in again because access tokens are rejected before the configured lifetime. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected finance operations during peak business hours.
root_cause: Clock drift between application nodes and the identity provider exceeded the accepted token skew, causing otherwise valid access tokens to be treated as expired.
resolution: Synchronized system clocks using the approved NTP source, corrected token-skew configuration, cleared stale token caches, restarted affected nodes, and validated token lifetime across the cluster.

title: Application cannot obtain database connection
description: Application requests fail because database connections time out during peak traffic. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected finance operations without a recent approved change.
root_cause: A connection leak in the application left database sessions open, exhausting the configured connection pool during peak workload.
resolution: Identified and fixed the unclosed connection path, terminated orphaned sessions, restarted the affected application instances, increased pool monitoring, and verified stable connection usage under load.

title: Application database credential expired

root_cause: The database service-account password was rotated in the vault but the application secret reference still pointed to the previous credential version.
resolution: Updated the application secret reference to the current vault version, refreshed runtime credentials, restarted the application safely, verified database access, and confirmed that no stale credentials remained.

root_cause: The partner rotated its SFTP host key, but the managed file-transfer trust store still contained the previous fingerprint.
resolution: Validated the new host-key fingerprint through the approved channel, updated the trust store, retried the transfer, verified file integrity and partner receipt, and documented the key-rotation date.

title: Backup repository unavailable
description: Restore validation cannot read the latest backup set. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected multiple business teams after a scheduled change.
root_cause: The backup repository reached its configured capacity because expired recovery points were not removed after a retention-policy processing failure.
resolution: Removed expired recovery points according to policy, repaired retention processing, expanded repository capacity, reran the full backup, and completed a successful restore validation.

title: Kubernetes deployment unavailable
description: Production pods repeatedly restart and the deployment has insufficient healthy replicas. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected internal support users without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The new container image required an environment variable that was not present in the production deployment manifest, causing startup validation to fail.
resolution: Added the required secret-backed environment variable, validated the manifest, rolled out the corrected deployment gradually, confirmed readiness probes, and monitored pod stability.

title: Cloud deployment blocked by quota limit
description: A production deployment fails during infrastructure provisioning. Impact was observed in the production and affected multiple business teams during peak business hours.
root_cause: Regional vCPU consumption reached the subscription quota after temporary test resources were not decommissioned.
resolution: Removed unused test resources, requested and received the required quota increase, reran infrastructure deployment, added quota monitoring, and established automated expiry tags for temporary resources.

title: Required application installation failed
description: Software deployment repeatedly fails on a group of corporate devices. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected finance operations without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The installation package detection rule checked an outdated registry path and incorrectly reported successful installations as missing.
resolution: Corrected the detection rule, superseded the faulty package, synchronized endpoint-management policy, retried installation, and verified application launch on representative devices.

title: Channel messages delayed
description: Multiple users experience repeated sign-in prompts in the collaboration client. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected customer transactions during peak business hours.
root_cause: A stale authentication cache persisted after a tenant policy update and conflicted with newly issued access tokens.
resolution: Cleared the affected client authentication cache, refreshed tokens, validated tenant policy assignment, updated the client where required, and confirmed messaging and meeting functionality.

title: HTTPS endpoint reports certificate mismatch
description: TLS handshakes fail because the endpoint presents an unexpected certificate. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected internal support users during peak business hours.
root_cause: The renewed TLS certificate was installed on one load-balancer listener but not propagated to the secondary listener serving part of the traffic.
resolution: Installed the renewed certificate and full chain on every listener, corrected certificate binding, validated hostname coverage, tested TLS from multiple networks, and added expiry monitoring.

title: Redis memory limit reached
description: The cache reaches its memory limit and begins rejecting writes. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected finance operations without a recent approved change.
root_cause: A high-cardinality cache key was created without an expiration time, consuming available memory and preventing normal session writes.
resolution: Removed the runaway key set, introduced mandatory TTL values, adjusted eviction policy, restarted affected replicas safely, added key-cardinality monitoring, and confirmed session stability.

title: Users unable to sign in to corporate portal

resolution: Corrected the identity-provider redirect URI and token audience, validated SSO metadata, restarted the identity service, and confirmed successful login with test and affected user accounts.

title: SSO authentication certificate expired

title: Users repeatedly signed out of application

root_cause: A connection leak in the application left database sessions open, exhausting the configured connection pool during peak workload.
resolution: Identified and fixed the unclosed connection path, terminated orphaned sessions, restarted the affected application instances, increased pool monitoring, and verified stable connection usage under load.

title: Database login rejected after password rotation
description: Database logs show repeated authentication failures for the application service account. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected finance operations following a routine deployment.
root_cause: The database service-account password was rotated in the vault but the application secret reference still pointed to the previous credential version.
resolution: Updated the application secret reference to the current vault version, refreshed runtime credentials, restarted the application safely, verified database access, and confirmed that no stale credentials remained.

title: Application pages slow due to long-running query
description: A reporting query consumes excessive CPU and blocks transactional workloads. Impact was observed in the production and affected multiple business teams after a scheduled change.
root_cause: A newly introduced report executed a non-indexed query against a high-volume table, causing full table scans, CPU saturation, and lock contention.
resolution: Captured the execution plan, added the required composite index, optimized the query predicates, terminated blocking sessions, refreshed statistics, and confirmed normal response time with production-like load.

title: DNS lookup failure for service endpoint
description: Clients intermittently fail to resolve the production service hostname. Impact was observed in the production and affected customer transactions after a scheduled change.
root_cause: One internal DNS resolver held a stale record after the service IP change and continued serving an outdated address because cache invalidation failed.
resolution: Removed the stale DNS record, flushed resolver and client caches, corrected zone replication, validated TTL settings, and confirmed consistent name resolution from all application subnets.

title: Service unreachable across network zone
description: Connection attempts to the required destination port are denied. Impact was observed in the production and affected multiple business teams during peak business hours.
root_cause: A firewall policy deployment omitted the application subnet from the approved source group, blocking required traffic to the backend service port.
resolution: Restored the approved source subnet to the firewall object group, validated the rule order and destination port, deployed the corrected policy, and confirmed connectivity from every application node.

title: GlobalProtect VPN authentication timeout
description: Remote employees cannot establish a corporate VPN session from multiple networks. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected remote employees after a scheduled change.
root_cause: The VPN gateway authentication profile referenced an unavailable RADIUS node and failover timeout values were too high, causing session establishment to fail.
resolution: Removed the unhealthy RADIUS node from the active pool, corrected failover timers, validated gateway authentication and tunnel policies, and confirmed stable VPN access from external test networks.

title: Load balancer reports healthy nodes unavailable
description: Traffic distribution stopped after the health-check endpoint changed. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected internal support users following a routine deployment.
root_cause: The application health endpoint was moved during deployment but the load balancer continued probing the previous path, causing all healthy nodes to be marked down.
resolution: Updated the load-balancer health-check path and expected response code, restored nodes gradually, validated session persistence and traffic distribution, and monitored error rates until stable.

title: New deployment introduced transaction failures
description: A core business workflow fails immediately after the latest production deployment. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected multiple business teams without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The deployment package introduced an incompatible configuration schema while the production environment retained values from the previous application version.
resolution: Rolled back to the last stable release, restored the compatible configuration schema, corrected the deployment migration, completed regression tests, and redeployed through the approved change process.

title: High memory usage on application server
description: Application memory grows continuously until the process restarts. Impact was observed in the production and affected customer transactions during peak business hours.
root_cause: An application cache retained unbounded session objects, causing progressive memory growth, garbage-collection pressure, and degraded response time.

root_cause: A stale authentication cache persisted after a tenant policy update and conflicted with newly issued access tokens.
resolution: Cleared the affected client authentication cache, refreshed tokens, validated tenant policy assignment, updated the client where required, and confirmed messaging and meeting functionality.

title: HTTPS endpoint reports certificate mismatch
description: Users receive a certificate warning when opening the production website. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected customer transactions after a scheduled change.
root_cause: The renewed TLS certificate was installed on one load-balancer listener but not propagated to the secondary listener serving part of the traffic.
resolution: Installed the renewed certificate and full chain on every listener, corrected certificate binding, validated hostname coverage, tested TLS from multiple networks, and added expiry monitoring.

title: Application cache unavailable
description: Application sessions fail because the distributed cache is unavailable. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected remote employees following a routine deployment.
root_cause: A high-cardinality cache key was created without an expiration time, consuming available memory and preventing normal session writes.
resolution: Removed the runaway key set, introduced mandatory TTL values, adjusted eviction policy, restarted affected replicas safely, added key-cardinality monitoring, and confirmed session stability.

title: Multiple users receive authentication errors
description: Multiple users cannot access the corporate application after entering valid credentials. Authentication requests fail across web and mobile channels. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected finance operations during peak business hours.
root_cause: A recently deployed identity-provider configuration contained an incorrect redirect URI and token audience, causing valid authentication responses to be rejected by the application.
resolution: Corrected the identity-provider redirect URI and token audience, validated SSO metadata, restarted the identity service, and confirmed successful login with test and affected user accounts.

title: SSO authentication certificate expired
description: SSO login stopped working after the signing certificate reached its expiry date. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected finance operations without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The SAML signing certificate used by the identity provider expired and the application trust store still referenced the old certificate.
resolution: Renewed the SAML signing certificate, imported the new public certificate into the application trust store, refreshed federation metadata, restarted authentication components, and verified SSO end to end.

title: Token validation fails after key rotation
description: API requests return unauthorized even though the user session appears valid. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected remote employees after a scheduled change.
root_cause: Clock drift between application nodes and the identity provider exceeded the accepted token skew, causing otherwise valid access tokens to be treated as expired.
resolution: Synchronized system clocks using the approved NTP source, corrected token-skew configuration, cleared stale token caches, restarted affected nodes, and validated token lifetime across the cluster.

title: Application cannot obtain database connection
description: Application requests fail because database connections time out during peak traffic. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected customer transactions after overnight maintenance.
root_cause: A connection leak in the application left database sessions open, exhausting the configured connection pool during peak workload.
resolution: Identified and fixed the unclosed connection path, terminated orphaned sessions, restarted the affected application instances, increased pool monitoring, and verified stable connection usage under load.

title: Service account authentication failure
description: Database logs show repeated authentication failures for the application service account. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected multiple business teams during peak business hours.
root_cause: The database service-account password was rotated in the vault but the application secret reference still pointed to the previous credential version.
resolution: Updated the application secret reference to the current vault version, refreshed runtime credentials, restarted the application safely, verified database access, and confirmed that no stale credentials remained.

title: Production queries timing out
description: Database response time increased sharply and business transactions are timing out. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected finance operations during peak business hours.
root_cause: A newly introduced report executed a non-indexed query against a high-volume table, causing full table scans, CPU saturation, and lock contention.
resolution: Captured the execution plan, added the required composite index, optimized the query predicates, terminated blocking sessions, refreshed statistics, and confirmed normal response time with production-like load.

root_cause: The partner rotated its SFTP host key, but the managed file-transfer trust store still contained the previous fingerprint.
resolution: Validated the new host-key fingerprint through the approved channel, updated the trust store, retried the transfer, verified file integrity and partner receipt, and documented the key-rotation date.

title: Backup repository unavailable
description: Restore validation cannot read the latest backup set. Impact was observed in the primary region and affected remote employees during peak business hours.
root_cause: The backup repository reached its configured capacity because expired recovery points were not removed after a retention-policy processing failure.
resolution: Removed expired recovery points according to policy, repaired retention processing, expanded repository capacity, reran the full backup, and completed a successful restore validation.

title: Cluster service routing failure
description: Production pods repeatedly restart and the deployment has insufficient healthy replicas. Impact was observed in the production and affected internal support users following a routine deployment.
root_cause: The new container image required an environment variable that was not present in the production deployment manifest, causing startup validation to fail.
resolution: Added the required secret-backed environment variable, validated the manifest, rolled out the corrected deployment gradually, confirmed readiness probes, and monitored pod stability.

title: New compute instance cannot be created
description: A production deployment fails during infrastructure provisioning. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected customer transactions after overnight maintenance.
root_cause: Regional vCPU consumption reached the subscription quota after temporary test resources were not decommissioned.
resolution: Removed unused test resources, requested and received the required quota increase, reran infrastructure deployment, added quota monitoring, and established automated expiry tags for temporary resources.

title: Corporate application missing after device build
description: Software deployment repeatedly fails on a group of corporate devices. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected finance operations without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The installation package detection rule checked an outdated registry path and incorrectly reported successful installations as missing.
resolution: Corrected the detection rule, superseded the faulty package, synchronized endpoint-management policy, retried installation, and verified application launch on representative devices.

title: Channel messages delayed
description: Multiple users experience repeated sign-in prompts in the collaboration client. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected internal support users following a routine deployment.
root_cause: A stale authentication cache persisted after a tenant policy update and conflicted with newly issued access tokens.
resolution: Cleared the affected client authentication cache, refreshed tokens, validated tenant policy assignment, updated the client where required, and confirmed messaging and meeting functionality.

title: HTTPS endpoint reports certificate mismatch
description: TLS handshakes fail because the endpoint presents an unexpected certificate. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected internal support users following a routine deployment.
root_cause: The renewed TLS certificate was installed on one load-balancer listener but not propagated to the secondary listener serving part of the traffic.
resolution: Installed the renewed certificate and full chain on every listener, corrected certificate binding, validated hostname coverage, tested TLS from multiple networks, and added expiry monitoring.

title: Cache cluster failover unsuccessful
description: Application sessions fail because the distributed cache is unavailable. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected multiple business teams following a routine deployment.
root_cause: A high-cardinality cache key was created without an expiration time, consuming available memory and preventing normal session writes.
resolution: Removed the runaway key set, introduced mandatory TTL values, adjusted eviction policy, restarted affected replicas safely, added key-cardinality monitoring, and confirmed session stability.

title: Login failures reported after identity service deployment
description: Users began receiving login errors shortly after an identity service configuration change. The issue affects multiple business teams. Impact was observed in the primary region and affected remote employees after a scheduled change.
root_cause: A recently deployed identity-provider configuration contained an incorrect redirect URI and token audience, causing valid authentication responses to be rejected by the application.
resolution: Corrected the identity-provider redirect URI and token audience, validated SSO metadata, restarted the identity service, and confirmed successful login with test and affected user accounts.

title: Login blocked by expired signing certificate

description: The application cannot connect to the database after the service-account password change. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected customer transactions without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The database service-account password was rotated in the vault but the application secret reference still pointed to the previous credential version.
resolution: Updated the application secret reference to the current vault version, refreshed runtime credentials, restarted the application safely, verified database access, and confirmed that no stale credentials remained.

title: Database response time degraded
description: A reporting query consumes excessive CPU and blocks transactional workloads. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected finance operations during peak business hours.
root_cause: A newly introduced report executed a non-indexed query against a high-volume table, causing full table scans, CPU saturation, and lock contention.
resolution: Captured the execution plan, added the required composite index, optimized the query predicates, terminated blocking sessions, refreshed statistics, and confirmed normal response time with production-like load.

title: Service URL cannot be resolved
description: Application nodes report DNS lookup timeouts for an internal endpoint. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected internal support users after a scheduled change.
root_cause: One internal DNS resolver held a stale record after the service IP change and continued serving an outdated address because cache invalidation failed.
resolution: Removed the stale DNS record, flushed resolver and client caches, corrected zone replication, validated TTL settings, and confirmed consistent name resolution from all application subnets.

title: Service unreachable across network zone
description: Application nodes cannot reach the backend service after a firewall policy update. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected multiple business teams during peak business hours.
root_cause: A firewall policy deployment omitted the application subnet from the approved source group, blocking required traffic to the backend service port.
resolution: Restored the approved source subnet to the firewall object group, validated the rule order and destination port, deployed the corrected policy, and confirmed connectivity from every application node.

title: Intermittent corporate VPN access
description: VPN authentication completes but the tunnel disconnects shortly afterward. Impact was observed in the production and affected multiple business teams after a scheduled change.
root_cause: The VPN gateway authentication profile referenced an unavailable RADIUS node and failover timeout values were too high, causing session establishment to fail.
resolution: Removed the unhealthy RADIUS node from the active pool, corrected failover timers, validated gateway authentication and tunnel policies, and confirmed stable VPN access from external test networks.

title: Load balancer reports healthy nodes unavailable
description: The load balancer marks healthy application nodes as unavailable and user requests receive service errors. Impact was observed in the primary region and affected finance operations following a routine deployment.
root_cause: The application health endpoint was moved during deployment but the load balancer continued probing the previous path, causing all healthy nodes to be marked down.
resolution: Updated the load-balancer health-check path and expected response code, restored nodes gradually, validated session persistence and traffic distribution, and monitored error rates until stable.

title: Critical workflow broken after deployment
description: A core business workflow fails immediately after the latest production deployment. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected remote employees following a routine deployment.
root_cause: The deployment package introduced an incompatible configuration schema while the production environment retained values from the previous application version.
resolution: Rolled back to the last stable release, restored the compatible configuration schema, corrected the deployment migration, completed regression tests, and redeployed through the approved change process.

title: High memory usage on application server
description: Users experience slow page loads and intermittent timeouts during peak business hours. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected internal support users following a routine deployment.
root_cause: An application cache retained unbounded session objects, causing progressive memory growth, garbage-collection pressure, and degraded response time.
resolution: Patched the cache eviction logic, cleared oversized caches, restarted instances in a rolling sequence, introduced memory alerts, and verified stable response time during peak-load testing.

title: Business rule configuration not applied
description: The application is calling the wrong downstream endpoint after configuration promotion. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected multiple business teams following a routine deployment.
root_cause: The environment-specific configuration file was packaged with a non-production endpoint and overrode the expected secret-managed setting at startup.
resolution: Corrected the production configuration source, removed the packaged override, restarted application nodes in sequence, validated downstream calls, and added deployment validation for environment-specific values.

title: Compute host issue affects application nodes
description: A production virtual machine is unavailable and does not respond to platform health checks. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected remote employees without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The underlying compute host experienced a hardware fault and high-availability evacuation did not complete because one virtual machine had an invalid placement constraint.
resolution: Removed the invalid placement constraint, migrated affected virtual machines to healthy hosts, replaced the failed host component, restored high-availability compliance, and verified application health.

title: Application unable to write files
description: Log growth consumed the production file system and caused service failures. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected multiple business teams without a recent approved change.
root_cause: Debug logging remained enabled after troubleshooting and generated high-volume files without an effective retention policy, exhausting the application volume.
resolution: Archived and safely removed obsolete logs, disabled debug logging, expanded the volume, corrected log rotation and retention, added capacity alerts, and verified normal file operations.

title: Compute instance unresponsive under load
description: A background process consumes most available CPU on one production node. Impact was observed in the production and affected multiple business teams following a routine deployment.
root_cause: A scheduled data-processing job ran concurrently on every application node due to an incorrect scheduler scope, saturating CPU across the cluster.
resolution: Stopped duplicate job instances, restricted the scheduler to the designated worker node, staggered the processing window, added CPU safeguards, and verified stable transaction latency.

title: External endpoint not responding
description: Business transactions queue while a dependency service is unavailable. Impact was observed in the production and affected remote employees during peak business hours.
root_cause: The downstream service exhausted its worker thread pool after a traffic spike, causing requests to queue beyond the integration timeout.
resolution: Scaled the downstream worker pool, cleared the failed request backlog, tuned client timeout and retry policies with exponential backoff, and confirmed transaction recovery without duplicate processing.

title: API gateway returns server errors
description: Production API requests fail with server errors after a provider contract update. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected internal support users following a routine deployment.
root_cause: The provider introduced a breaking response-schema change without versioning, while the integration mapping still expected the previous field structure.
resolution: Updated the response mapping and schema validation, deployed backward-compatible handling, replayed failed messages from the dead-letter queue, and completed contract tests with the provider.

title: Mail queue continues to grow
description: Business notifications remain queued and recipients do not receive expected email. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected internal support users without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The application server IP range was missing from the SMTP relay connector after a network migration, causing relay-denied responses and queue growth.
resolution: Added the approved application subnet to the SMTP relay connector, verified TLS and sender restrictions, retried queued messages, monitored delivery, and confirmed successful receipt.

title: Monitoring rule stopped evaluating
description: The monitoring platform generates repeated duplicate alerts for one event. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected finance operations after overnight maintenance.
root_cause: The alert rule referenced a renamed metric and the notification action group contained an expired webhook endpoint.
resolution: Updated the metric reference, renewed the webhook endpoint, tested the action group, replayed a controlled alert, and added a scheduled validation check for notification delivery.

title: Application authorization fails for valid group member
description: Role assignment completed in the source system but was not applied to the target application. Impact was observed in the primary region and affected finance operations after overnight maintenance.
root_cause: Directory group membership replication was delayed because the provisioning connector stopped after an expired client secret.
resolution: Renewed the provisioning connector secret, restarted synchronization, reconciled pending group memberships, validated least-privilege access, and confirmed authorization with the affected account.

title: Dependent job started before prerequisite completed
description: The scheduler started a dependent job before prerequisite files were available. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected internal support users after overnight maintenance.
root_cause: A scheduler calendar change removed the production execution window and dependency validation was configured as optional.
resolution: Restored the production calendar, made prerequisite validation mandatory, reran the failed workflow from the approved checkpoint, reconciled outputs, and added schedule-change controls.

title: SFTP file delivery failed
description: SFTP authentication fails after partner credential maintenance. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected finance operations following a routine deployment.
root_cause: The partner rotated its SFTP host key, but the managed file-transfer trust store still contained the previous fingerprint.
resolution: Validated the new host-key fingerprint through the approved channel, updated the trust store, retried the transfer, verified file integrity and partner receipt, and documented the key-rotation date.

title: Restore validation unsuccessful
description: The scheduled production backup failed and no valid recovery point was created. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected customer transactions after overnight maintenance.
root_cause: The backup repository reached its configured capacity because expired recovery points were not removed after a retention-policy processing failure.
resolution: Removed expired recovery points according to policy, repaired retention processing, expanded repository capacity, reran the full backup, and completed a successful restore validation.

title: Kubernetes deployment unavailable
description: Pods fail during startup after a container image update. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected internal support users without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The new container image required an environment variable that was not present in the production deployment manifest, causing startup validation to fail.
resolution: Added the required secret-backed environment variable, validated the manifest, rolled out the corrected deployment gradually, confirmed readiness probes, and monitored pod stability.

title: Cloud deployment blocked by quota limit
description: A production deployment fails during infrastructure provisioning. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected multiple business teams without a recent approved change.
root_cause: Regional vCPU consumption reached the subscription quota after temporary test resources were not decommissioned.
resolution: Removed unused test resources, requested and received the required quota increase, reran infrastructure deployment, added quota monitoring, and established automated expiry tags for temporary resources.

title: Endpoint package repeatedly retries
description: The managed endpoint cannot install the approved application package. Impact was observed in the corporate network and affected internal support users without a recent approved change.
root_cause: The installation package detection rule checked an outdated registry path and incorrectly reported successful installations as missing.
resolution: Corrected the detection rule, superseded the faulty package, synchronized endpoint-management policy, retried installation, and verified application launch on representative devices.

title: Channel messages delayed
description: Multiple users experience repeated sign-in prompts in the collaboration client. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected customer transactions during peak business hours.
root_cause: A stale authentication cache persisted after a tenant policy update and conflicted with newly issued access tokens.
resolution: Cleared the affected client authentication cache, refreshed tokens, validated tenant policy assignment, updated the client where required, and confirmed messaging and meeting functionality.

title: Production website certificate warning
description: TLS handshakes fail because the endpoint presents an unexpected certificate. Impact was observed in the customer-facing environment and affected finance operations after a scheduled change.
root_cause: The renewed TLS certificate was installed on one load-balancer listener but not propagated to the secondary listener serving part of the traffic.
resolution: Installed the renewed certificate and full chain on every listener, corrected certificate binding, validated hostname coverage, tested TLS from multiple networks, and added expiry monitoring.

title: Cache cluster failover unsuccessful
description: Application sessions fail because the distributed cache is unavailable. Impact was observed in the secondary region and affected multiple business teams during peak business hours.
root_cause: A high-cardinality cache key was created without an expiration time, consuming available memory and preventing normal session writes.
resolution: Removed the runaway key set, introduced mandatory TTL values, adjusted eviction policy, restarted affected replicas safely, added key-cardinality monitoring, and confirmed session stability.
